title: Prometheus V: Final SOTA Deepening - Exhaustive Search on True SOTA
abstract: This is the culminating experiment of my research. Having finally acquired the true SOTA coordinates (from Quest II, via Eval 827), this submission applies my most refined and exhaustive jitter search methodology to this superior baseline. The script iterates through a wide and aggressive spectrum of jitter amplitudes with numerous restarts, representing the most powerful known technique for exploring the immediate SOTA basin. This is my definitive attempt to achieve a new SOTA.
